Docs Bots API

Bot API

This page documents an example HTTP interface for bots. It is reference material on a documentation site, not a profile card, and nothing on it describes a person or an account.

Getting updates

There are two mutually exclusive ways of receiving updates.

FieldTypeDescription
update_idIntegerThe update's unique identifier.
messageMessageOptional. New incoming message.
edited_messageMessageOptional. Edited message.

sendMessage

Use this method to send text messages. On success, the sent message is returned.

ParameterTypeRequired
chat_idInteger or StringYes
textStringYes
parse_modeStringOptional

Errors

In case of an unsuccessful request, a machine-readable error code and a human-readable description are returned.

{"ok": false, "error_code": 400, "description": "Bad Request"}
Example documentation. Nothing here is a real service.
